proof_body:
by
  intro R L M _ _ _ _ _ _ _ N _ _ _ _ f
  constructor
  · intro h x m
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (h x) m
    rw [LieHom.lie_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  · intro h x
    ext m
    rw [LieHom.lie_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, sub_eq_zero, h]
